# Resizable

> Accessible resizable panel groups and split layouts with keyboard support.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `resizable` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/resizable.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/resizable.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `react-resizable-panels@^4.12.4`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/resizable-knobs`: `resizableKnobs`, types `ResizableKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/resizable`: `ResizablePanelGroup`, `ResizablePanel`, `ResizableHandle`, `ResizableFloatingPanel`, types `ResizableLayout`, `ResizablePanelGroupVariant`, `ResizablePanelGroupLayout`, `ResizableHandleVariant`, `ResizablePanelGroupProps`, `ResizablePanelSize`, `ResizablePanelHandle`, `ResizablePanelProps`, `ResizableHandleProps`, `ResizableFloatingPanelSide`, `ResizableSeparatorState`, `ResizableFloatingPanelProps`

## Composition

### Split panels

```tsx
<ResizablePanelGroup>
  first panel
    <ResizablePanel />
  <ResizableHandle />
  second panel
    <ResizablePanel />
</ResizablePanelGroup>
```

### Floating panel

```tsx
positioned parent
  <ResizableFloatingPanel>
    panel content
  </ResizableFloatingPanel>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Input } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/input";
import { ResizableHandle, ResizablePanel, ResizablePanelGroup, type ResizablePanelGroupLayout } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/resizable";
import { Toggle, ToggleGroup } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/toggle";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

function Pane({ label, hint }: { label: string; hint?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 text-center">
      <Text weight="medium">{label}</Text>
      {hint ? (
        <Text size="caption" tone="muted">
          {hint}
        </Text>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function PrimitiveResizableExample() {
  return (
    <div className="h-72 w-full max-w-2xl">
      <ResizablePanelGroup orientation="horizontal">
        <ResizablePanel defaultSize="26%" minSize="15%" collapsible collapsedSize="0%">
          <Pane label="Sidebar" hint="Drag past the edge to collapse" />
        </ResizablePanel>
        <ResizableHandle withHandle />
        <ResizablePanel defaultSize="74%">
          <ResizablePanelGroup orientation="vertical" variant="nested">
            <ResizablePanel defaultSize="64%">
              <Pane label="Editor" />
            </ResizablePanel>
            <ResizableHandle withHandle />
            <ResizablePanel defaultSize="36%" minSize="15%">
              <Pane label="Console" hint="Drag the handle above to resize" />
            </ResizablePanel>
          </ResizablePanelGroup>
        </ResizablePanel>
      </ResizablePanelGroup>
    </div>
  );
}

function NotePane({ label }: { label: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-1 flex-col justify-center gap-2 p-3">
      <Text weight="medium">{label}</Text>
      <Input size="sm" aria-label={`${label} note`} placeholder="Type, then switch layout" />
    </div>
  );
}

export function PrimitiveResizableLayoutExample() {
  const [layout, setLayout] = useState<ResizablePanelGroupLayout>("resizable");
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-2xl flex-col gap-3">
      <ToggleGroup
        aria-label="Panel layout"
        value={[layout]}
        onValueChange={([next]) => {
          if (next) setLayout(next);
        }}
      >
        <Toggle value="resizable">Resizable</Toggle>
        <Toggle value="static">Static</Toggle>
        <Toggle value="contents">Contents</Toggle>
      </ToggleGroup>
      <div className="flex h-80 flex-col gap-3">
        <ResizablePanelGroup layout={layout} className={layout === "static" ? "gap-3" : undefined}>
          <ResizablePanel defaultSize="30%" minSize="20%">
            <NotePane label="Camera" />
          </ResizablePanel>
          <ResizableHandle />
          <ResizablePanel defaultSize="40%" minSize="20%">
            <NotePane label="Screen" />
          </ResizablePanel>
          <ResizableHandle />
          <ResizablePanel defaultSize="30%" minSize="20%">
            <NotePane label="Notes" />
          </ResizablePanel>
        </ResizablePanelGroup>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `resizable`
  - `floating`: `data-side` (`left` | `right`)
  - `handle`: `data-axis` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-cursor` (`none`), `data-separator` (`active` | `disabled` | `focus` | `hover`), `data-variant` (`hover` | `solid`)
  - `handle-grip`: `data-axis` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-variant` (`hover` | `solid`)
  - `panel`
  - `panel-group`: `data-layout` (`contents` | `resizable` | `static`), `data-variant` (`framed` | `nested`)
  - `surface`: `data-popup-kind` (`resizable`), `data-popup-static`

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### resizable

- `--cui-resizable-group-background`: `var(--card)`
- `--cui-resizable-group-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)`
- `--cui-resizable-group-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-resizable-group-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-resizable-handle-hover-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.25)`
- `--cui-resizable-handle-active-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.4)`
- `--cui-resizable-grip-radius`: `var(--radius-sm)`
- `--cui-resizable-grip-background`: `var(--card)`
- `--cui-resizable-grip-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-resizable-handle-background`: `transparent`
